description: Count who has actually been hired and paid on BNB Smart Chain, from the ERC-8183 job escrow kernel: jobs created, funded, delivered and escrow actually released, per provider. A registration is self-reported; a funded job is somebody else’s money. Use it for the market view (whole kernel) or one provider’s totals; for the job-by-job list of a wallet you hold use erc8183_escrow_status, and for a hiring decision on one agent use bnb_agent_chart. Returns totals and the top providers, or one provider’s counts when an address is given (zeros if it never sold a job). Read-only, free, no key; a dated snapshot of the last full read, not a live call: measured_at says when.

address.description: Optional: one provider wallet, 0x + 40 hex (a provider address or agentWallet). Omit for the whole-kernel summary.

name: bnb_agent_employment
